locations.name: Bahen 1F
locations.brief_description: You are on the first floor of the Bahen Center. There are elevators to the West, and an exit from the building to St. George street to the East. You see something shiny on the ground -- looks like a toonie?
locations.long_description: You are on the first floor of the Bahen Center. It's usually crowded at this time of the day, but today it's eerily quiet. Only a few students are studying at the table near the doors. You better not disturb them. One student is rushing down the corridor, wearing a heavy-looking backpack and carrying a textbook in their arms. There are elevators to the West, and an exit from the building to St. George street to the East.

locations.name: Paul's Office
locations.brief_description: You are in the Paul's Office
locations.long_description: You are now in the Paul's Office, Paul is standing there. He loves soving confusion for his students.

locations.name: elevator 1F
locations.long_description: You are now in the elevator 1F, you can press the button and go to 2F

locations.name: elevator 2F
locations.brief_description: You are on the second floor of the Bahen Center. There are elevators to the West and a lab room
locations.long_description: You are on the second floor of the Bahen Center. It's usually crowded at this time of the day, but today it's eerily quiet. Only a few students are studying at the table near the doors. An empty lecture room. There is an elevator to the West and a locked Lab Room

locations.name: Lecture Room
locations.brief_description: You are in the lecture room
locations.long_description: You are now in the lecture room. There was a student who seemed to be looking for something.

locations.name: Lab Room
locations.brief_description: You are now in front of lab room
locations.long_description: You are now in the lab room. It is locked. You must use key to enter this room

locations.name: your dorm room
locations.brief_description: This is your room in New College. It's messy but homey.
locations.long_description: You are in your dorm room. There's a desk with some items on it and a bed that hasn't been made in days. The only exit is South to the front desk area.

items.name: the door of Study Room
items.brief_description: It's a Study room in your dorm, however, you cannot enter it even if you push very hard.
items.long_description: You can see an upside-down note sticking on the door that says 'push'

items.name: the Study Room
items.brief_description: You enter the quiet study room in New College.
items.long_description: This study room is filled with carrels and heavy silence. You see a computer terminal in the corner. You see your usb drive is left on the table

items.name: New College Lobby
items.brief_description: You are in the bustling New College Lobby.
items.long_description: The lobby is busy with students. From here, you can head East to go back outside, South toward the Front Desk, or North to the Study Room.

items.name: the Front Desk
items.brief_description: You are at the New College front desk.
items.long_description: This is the Front Desk. They have a Lost and Found here. And it is the place to look if you lose your room key. To the North is the corridor leading to the dorm room, and to the South is the study room.

items.name: outside New College
items.brief_description: You are standing in front of the New College building.
items.long_description: Students are lounging on the nearby benches. Looking around, you see the main entrance leading into the building to the West.

items.name: the Robarts Library
items.brief_description: You are standing outside the Robarts Library. The entrance is right in front of you. You’ll need a T-Card to enter the building.
items.long_description: You are standing outside the Robarts Library. Students walk in and out quietly, tapping their T-Cards at the entrance gates. You’ll need a T-Card to enter the building.

items.name: the Robarts Library 1F
items.brief_description: You are on the first floor of the Robarts Library. There are elevators to the West, public computers to the East,the bookshelves to the North, and an exit from the building to Huron Street to the South.
items.long_description: You are on the first floor of the Robarts Library. Students pass by quietly, some heading toward the elevators while others sit at nearby computers. There are elevators to the West, public computers to the East, bookshelves to the North, and an exit from the building to Huron Street to the South.

items.name: elevators on 1F
items.brief_description: You are standing in front of the elevators. You can take the elevator up to the second floor.
items.long_description: You are standing in front of the elevators. A small sign shows that the current floor is the first floor. You can take the elevator up to the second floor.

items.name: computer area
items.brief_description: There are many computers. This is a great place to study.
items.long_description: There are many computers. Many students are working in focused silence. This would be a great place to study—if you had time.

items.name: book shelves
items.brief_description: Tall bookshelves surround you. This can be a great place to read books and learn more about how to improve your project.
items.long_description: Tall bookshelves surround you. This can be a great place to read books and learn more about how to improve your project, but the deadline is creeping closer.

items.name: elevators on 2F
items.brief_description: You are standing in front of the elevators. You can take the elevator down to the first floor.
items.long_description: You are standing in front of the elevators. A small sign shows that the current floor is the second floor. You can take the elevator down to the first floor.

items.name: the Robarts Library 2F
items.brief_description: You are on the second floor of the Robarts Library. There are elevators to the West, a study room to the East, and a cafeteria to the North.
items.long_description: You are on the second floor of the Robarts Library. This floor feels quieter and more focused. There are elevators to the West, a study room to the East, and a cafeteria to the North.

items.name: study room
items.brief_description: You are now in the study room.
items.long_description: You are now in the study room. It is very quiet. A few students are hunched over notebooks and laptops.

items.name: cafeteria
items.brief_description: You are now in the cafeteria.
items.long_description: You are now in the cafeteria. It smells faintly of coffee. A few abandoned cups sit on the tables. Something familiar catches your eye.

items.name: McLennan Physical Laboratories
items.brief_description: You are in the front of MP
items.long_description: You are now in the front of MP. Some classmates came out in a hurry as if they were discussing the hateful calculus.

items.name: Lecture Room 1

items.name: Lecture Room 2
items.long_description: You are now in the Lecture Room 2,you see your classmates are listening attentively (actually just daydreaming)

items.name: lucky mug
